data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'bianos', meaning 'shining'. The suffix 'cha' is of Hebrew origin, meaning 'God'. Thus, Biancha can be interpreted as 'Graceful Shining One of God'. The name Biancha carries the meaning “Graceful, Shining One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Biancha usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
